1:# CLI
2:
3:The `fah` / `fa` CLI (`bin/fah.dart`). Related: [providers.md](providers.md) for the provider catalog, [project-layout.md](project-layout.md) for the broader codebase.
4:
5:## Top-level
6:
7:- `bin/fah.dart` — the `fah`/`fa` CLI. REPL (no args) or headless (`fa "prompt"`/`-p`, mutually exclusive). First positional naming an EXISTING file is the prompt source (`.md`/`.txt` inlined, others attached by reference; `-p` is verbatim). Args parsed in `lib/src/cli/cli_args.dart` (pure Dart). Headless: exit 0/1/130; `CliIO` contract — `write` = primary stream, `writeln` = diagnostics (stderr headless). TUI leaves the mouse to the terminal by default (native select-to-copy); `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1` (`AgentCliConfig.tuiMouseCapture`) captures it for wheel scrolling.
8:
9:## REPL machinery
10:
11:- `lib/src/cli/` — REPL machinery: `/provider [name] [baseUrl] [token] | custom` (guided wizard in `provider_flow.dart` + `provider_commands.dart`), `/provider copilot` (device flow or pasted token; fine-grained PATs ride PAT mode — no exchange), `/provider export` + `/provider import` (issue #2090: the CURRENT provider via a passphrase-encrypted clipboard container; `/provider export cicd [auth]` for CI/CD JSON or the bare secret value), custom providers in `customProviders:` section of `~/.fah/config.yaml`. `/models` also manages `models:` section: `/models config`/`set <slot> <model> [baseUrl]`/`remove <slot>` (persisted via `onModelsConfigChanged`), `/model <name>` resolves `models.custom`. Keys: env first, then secure store (`lib/src/secrets/secure_key_store*.dart` — Keychain/Secret Service/PasswordVault, IO backends only in `lib/io.dart`), preloaded into `SecureKeyCache`. DEFAULT endpoint resolves env → `FA_KEY_<HOST>` → `FA_KEY_<HOST>_<NAME>` → legacy; other endpoints resolve ONLY scoped store keys; `/key set` writes store-only. ALL TUI pickers have type-to-filter + backspace. Provider→model pick flows in `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart` NAMED `SettingsFlow` extension (public `runProviderModelFlow`/`startChatModelFlow`/`startMediaSlotFlow`/`startAgentModelFlow`). Model-list fetch dispatches per dialect (`_fetchProviderModelIds`):
12:
13:| spec | endpoint | auth |
14:| --- | --- | --- |
15:| CodeMie (URL marker) | `/llm_models` | saved entry's own key |
16:| DIAL (`provider: 'dial'`) | `/openai/models` | `Api-Key` header |
17:| else | OpenAI `/models` | env / scoped store |
18:
19:Failures fall back to manual entry. `startAgentModelFlow` pins the `smol`/`subagent` role chains through `ModelRolesResolver.setRoleChain`/`clearRoleChain` (the resolver is created on demand when the config had no `roles:` section — `AgentCliConfig.modelRolesResolver` is mutable) and persists via `onModelsConfigChanged` (`bin/fah.dart`'s `persistConfig` reads the live resolver config).
20:
21:- `lib/src/prompts/prompt_overrides.dart` — `prompts:` config section maps prompt names to file path or inline text; strict validation; flags `--system-prompt(-file)` > config > built-in.
22:- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart` — full `fah --help` text, guarded by `test/cli/cli_help_test.dart` (update BOTH).
23:- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → Brave/Tavily keyed) and `web_fetch` (HTML→markdown, pub.dev handler) via `builtinTools(env, webSearch:)`.

1:# CI: daily auto-publish
2:
3:`daily-publish.yml` is a thin orchestrator that runs the five publish
4:channels once a day as isolated **legs**: one leg failing never kills the
5:others, and every failure self-files a GitHub issue. It duplicates no build
6:logic — each leg dispatches an existing workflow via `gh workflow run` and
7:watches the run.
8:
9:## Schedule and change detection
10:
11:- Cron `17 5 * * *` (daily, 05:17 UTC), plus manual `workflow_dispatch`.
12:- Legs run only when `main` moved since the last **green** daily run
13:  (compared by head SHA). No movement → every leg skips → the run stays
14:  **green** (the #159 lesson: a no-op must never be red). A dispatch can
15:  override with `force: true`.
16:- One daily at a time (`concurrency: daily-publish`, queued, never
17:  cancelled).
18:
19:## Legs
20:
21:| Leg | Runs | Publishes |
22:| --- | --- | --- |
23:| TestFlight | `build-mobile.yml` (`ios_content=all`, `android_content=none`) | iOS IPA → TestFlight, distributed straight to the EXTERNAL group (`TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP` repo variable + Beta App Review contact variables — lanes fail loudly without them). Android stays excluded (standing owner decision). |
24:| pub.dev | in-job | **Verifier + recovery**, never publishes directly: pub.dev trusted publishing only accepts OIDC from tag-push runs, which a schedule/dispatch run can never be. When behind, it classifies first (gh-1192): a tag-publish still **executing** (tag-run queued/in-progress at any age, or not visible yet / tag not cut while the bump is fresh) is a neutral **skipped: release in flight** — no error, no issue; the next daily re-verifies. Past the grace windows the recovery path applies: re-run the failed ci.yml tag-publish run (a rerun keeps the original tag-push event/OIDC claims); unrecoverable states fail loudly → issue with a manual-publish instruction. |
25:| CLI + desktop | `build-macos.yml` (`create_release=true`) | macOS DMG/ZIP (signed + notarized), macOS CLI bundles, `fa-extension.zip` → GitHub Release. |
26:| Website | `pages.yml` | fa1.dev: landing + web demo + `/extension/` + `/outlook/` slice. |
27:| Outlook add-in | `office-addin.yml` | Acceptance suite (manifest validation, dart2js taskpane, Node + Playwright e2e). The fa1.dev `/outlook` deploy itself rides the Website leg — `pages.yml` assembles the same add-in into the Pages artifact. |
28:
29:Manual, version-by-version: `release-appstore.yml` (workflow_dispatch) submits the
30:version's latest processed TestFlight build straight to App Store review (iOS and/or
31:macOS). Pre-flight fails before any mutation — version must exist (create it via
32:`store-metadata.yml`), a processed build must exist, an already-submitted version is a
33:green no-op — and `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly. Release-after-approval stays
34:a manual ASC click (`APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE` repo variable flips it).
35:
36:`workflow_dispatch` input `legs` selects a single leg (`all` by default) —
37:the safe way to smoke one channel.
38:
39:## Versioning
40:
41:The scheme (gh-1522): the git TAG is the single source of truth —

8:

10:BUNDLE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/fa-local/bundle"
11:INSTALL_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}"
12:
13:mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR/../lib"
14:
15:cd "$REPO_ROOT"

18:dart pub get >/dev/null 2>&1 || dart pub get

22:# tag is the single source of truth) — stamp the build version from git
23:# describe: the exact tag when HEAD is tagged, else <tag>-<n>-g<sha>[-dirty].
24:# A plain `dart run` (no install) shows 0.0.0-dev — acceptable and
25:# self-explanatory.
26:VERSION="$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)"
27:VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
28:echo "$VERSION" > "$BUNDLE_DIR/version.txt"

31:echo "→ Installing to $INSTALL_DIR..."
